text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. When I visited the cafeteria, 
Dream Journey was...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san! Thank you so much for the 
other day!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That chess book you recommended was so 
helpful! Thanks to it, I was able to play 
a great match against Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I'm honored to have been of 
help.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-san has great potential... I'm 
sure she'll become a wonderful player.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To say that I have natural talent, of all 
things...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It is the truth. If it's fine with you, 
Scarlet-san, I'd love to share more about 
tactics over a cup of tea.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, there's a cafe at the 
'Fuji View' mall where you can play chess 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go together next time? 
As thanks for the book, I can show you 
around some recommended shops!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall take you up on your 
offer. ...Fufu.
choice_data_list:
(Heh... Journey looks like he's having 
fun.)

(Heh... Journey looks like she's having 
fun.)

text_block_list.text:
Watching her chat so pleasantly gave me a 
sense of relief, but—

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
"A true princess must be! Splendid, 
elegant, and valiant! Blazing Princess ☆ 
Princess Fighter!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. So what's playing in the demo right 
now is... the movie version of the 
original PreFai?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The original generation is super popular 
among fans! It's an absolute must-watch 
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"‘☆'s’, ‘Fla-flat ♭’, ‘Sugar Love ♪’... 
My, what an extensive lineup of series."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As a beginner myself, I'm not really sure 
which one I should watch, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry! I shall 
personally guide you step by step!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's the least I can do to thank you for 
always serving tea! Ask away, as much as 
you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is most reassuring.

Seeing an unexpected side of her on our 
day off left me flustered. A few days 
after that incident—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Look at this magnificent gold 
craftsmanship! As expected of the artisan 
who took on the billionaire's engagement 
ring! Simply outstanding work!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's a tabloid show. My father's 
work was being featured.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I heard they received a commission from 
an overseas billionaire to craft an 
engagement ring. It's become quite a hot 
topic."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My father doesn't talk much, but when it 
comes to his work, he has immense 
dedication and integrity.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the limelight like this makes 
me genuinely happy from the bottom of my 
heart.

As she spoke, the TV talk show cut to 
footage of an interview with the 
billionaire who had commissioned the job.

text_block_list.name: Magnate
text_block_list.text:
"There were other candidates we considered 
commissioning, of course. In the end, the 
quality of the work was the deciding 
factor. That, and the Japanese spirit of 
hospitality, I suppose."

text_block_list.name: Magnate
text_block_list.text:
"They helped me pick out Japanese 
souvenirs at a mall called Fuji View... 
and looked after me in so many ways. I was 
deeply touched by their hospitality."
choice_data_list:
Huh? What was the name of that mall 
again...

text_block_list.name: Magnate
text_block_list.text:
"And I've actually been interested in 
Japanese anime for a while. Thanks to a 
new friend, I discovered a wonderful show 
called PriFie. Hahaha!"

I recalled the exchange I witnessed at the 
rental shop a few days ago. Was this 
coincidence, or...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, what is the matter? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, what is the matter? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well... even if you ask me, I wouldn't 
know.

Dream Journey smiled faintly. Somehow, I 
couldn't bring myself to ask any further.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Journey-san. Would you care to join me 
for some tea, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A coincidence? Whatever do you mean?

Dream Journey tilts her head. Could it 
really just be my imagination?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Journey-san. Would you care to join me 
for some tea, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'd really love to finish that chess 
match from the other day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I have some PreFigh merch 
I'd love to share with you~!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet-san, Kawakami-san. Thank you for 
inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Our conversation the other day was very 
helpful. Please tell me more sometime.
